title: Hope in the Lord outlives the world's reach
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 188
summary: The shabad begins by describing the one held so closely by the Lord that stain and worldly pressure cannot settle. It moves through freedom from anxiety and pain, then ends in the Guru who shows the Perfect Lord.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person living in anticipation of the next blow, opinion, or setback. Taken steadily, it relocates safety from changing circumstances to the One who keeps the heart.
takeaway: Let this stay with you: let hope in the Lord outrank the world's reach.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਭਏ ਸਮਰਥ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau tum bhe samarath a(n)gaa ||
lines.translation: Those who have You on their side, O All-powerful Lord
- no black stain can stick to them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਉ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadhau jaa kau hai aas tumaaree ||
lines.translation: O Lord of wealth, those who place their hopes in You

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kau kachh naahee sa(n)saaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: - nothing of the world can touch them at all. ||1||Pause||
Those whose hearts are filled with their Lord and Master

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau tum dheenee prabh dheer ||
lines.translation: Those, unto whom You give Your consolation, God

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: taa kai nikaT na aavai peer ||3||
lines.translation: - pain does not even approach them. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak mai so gur paiaa ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have found that Guru,
who has shown me the Perfect, Supreme Lord God. ||4||41||110||

structure: First, it begins by saying the world cannot finally mark the one supported by the Lord.
Then, it widens that protection into freedom from anxiety and even approaching pain.
Finally, it ends in gratitude for the Guru who reveals the Perfect Lord behind that steadiness.
